# Let us trace exact camera pose up to frame 40:
import json

with open("/work/history.jsonl") as f:
    history = [json.loads(line) for line in f]

x, y, theta = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 # theta in degrees, 0 = +y
import numpy as np

for i, h in enumerate(history):
    req = h.get("requested_action", {})
    t = req.get("turn_deg", 0)
    m = req.get("move_m", 0)
    theta = (theta + t) % 360
    rad = np.deg2rad(theta)
    # move along new heading
    x += m * np.sin(rad)
    y += m * np.cos(rad)
    print(f"Frame {h.get(\x27frame\x27, i+1)}: req=({t}, {m}), pose=({x:.4f}, {y:.4f}, {theta:.1f} deg)")
